parsed.post: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6 and achieved a significant drop in val_bpb (1.0405 -> 1.0142). Capacity seems to be a major factor. Next, I'll try increasing the MATRIX_LR slightly to see if a higher learning rate can accelerate convergence on this deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to find an optimal balance between model capacity and learning speed.
